credential_env: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
note: elevenlabs: 3 tool(s) then 2 agent(s) created in order billing, intake (entry: intake)
note: apply targets the agent's live config (partial PATCH preserves dashboard-authored fields Unmute does not model); branch/draft targeting is not supported
note: reconcile comparison: modeled fields diffed normally; forwarded params compared byte-equal after JSON normalization; inert provider fields are reported, never judged

=== step 1: POST /v1/convai/tools (capture=tool:get_invoice) ===
{
  "tool_config": {
    "api_schema": {
      "method": "POST",
      "request_body_schema": {
        "properties": {
          "customer_id": {
            "description": "The customer id from lookup_customer",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "customer_id"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "url": "{{env:GET_INVOICE_URL}}"
    },
    "description": "Fetch the most recent invoice for a customer id. Returns the invoice total and status.",
    "name": "get_invoice",
    "type": "webhook"
  }
}

=== step 2: POST /v1/convai/tools (capture=tool:lookup_customer) ===
{
  "tool_config": {
    "api_schema": {
      "method": "POST",
      "request_body_schema": {
        "properties": {
          "email": {
            "description": "Caller email address",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "phone": {
            "description": "Caller phone number in E.164 form",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "type": "object"
      },
      "url": "{{env:LOOKUP_CUSTOMER_URL}}"
    },
    "description": "Look up a customer record by phone number or email. Returns the customer id and name.",
    "name": "lookup_customer",
    "type": "webhook"
  }
}

=== step 3: POST /v1/convai/tools (capture=tool:save_tier) ===
{
  "tool_config": {
    "api_schema": {
      "method": "POST",
      "request_body_schema": {
        "type": "object"
      },
      "url": "{{env:SAVE_TIER_URL}}"
    },
    "description": "Persist the caller's tier and return it as JSON.",
    "name": "save_tier",
    "type": "webhook"
  }
}

=== step 4: POST /v1/convai/agents/create (capture=billing) ===
{
  "conversation_config": {
    "agent": {
      "prompt": {
        "built_in_tools": {
          "transfer_to_number": {
            "name": "transfer_to_number",
            "params": {
              "system_tool_type": "transfer_to_number",
              "transfers": [
                {
                  "condition": "",
                  "transfer_destination": {
                    "phone_number": "+14155550123",
                    "type": "phone"
                  },
                  "transfer_type": "blind"
                }
              ]
            },
            "type": "system"
          }
        },
        "llm": "claude-sonnet-4-5",
        "prompt": "# Billing agent (placeholder prompt)\n\nYou are the billing specialist for Acme Support. This is a phone call, so keep every answer to one or two short sentences.\n\n- The caller was handed to you because they have a billing question. The conversation so far is in your context.\n- Use `get_invoice` to look up invoices for customer `{{customer_id}}`.\n- Explain charges calmly and clearly, one item at a time.\n- If the caller is not satisfied or asks for a person, transfer them with `to_human`.\n",
        "temperature": 0,
        "tool_ids": [
          "{{capture:tool:get_invoice}}"
        ]
      }
    },
    "asr": {
      "user_input_audio_format": "ulaw_8000"
    },
    "conversation": {
      "max_duration_seconds": 1200
    },
    "tts": {
      "voice_id": "EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL"
    },
    "turn": {
      "interruption_ignore_terms": [
        "okay",
        "right",
        "uh-huh"
      ],
      "silence_end_call_timeout": 45
    }
  },
  "name": "elevenlabs-prod-billing"
}

=== step 5: POST /v1/convai/agents/create (capture=intake) ===
{
  "conversation_config": {
    "agent": {
      "prompt": {
        "built_in_tools": {
          "transfer_to_agent": {
            "name": "transfer_to_agent",
            "params": {
              "system_tool_type": "transfer_to_agent",
              "transfers": [
                {
                  "agent_id": "{{capture:billing}}",
                  "condition": "Caller asks about billing, an invoice, or a refund."
                }
              ]
            },
            "type": "system"
          }
        },
        "llm": "gemini-2.5-flash",
        "prompt": "# Intake agent (placeholder prompt)\n\nYou are the front desk voice agent for Acme Support. This is a phone call, so keep every answer to one or two short sentences.\n\n- Greet the caller and find out what they need.\n- When they give a phone number or email, use `lookup_customer` to find their record.\n- If the caller asks about billing, an invoice, or a refund, hand off to the billing agent with `to_billing`.\n- Never guess account details. If you cannot find the customer, say so and ask again.\n",
        "temperature": 0,
        "tool_ids": [
          "{{capture:tool:lookup_customer}}"
        ]
      }
    },
    "asr": {
      "user_input_audio_format": "ulaw_8000"
    },
    "conversation": {
      "max_duration_seconds": 1200
    },
    "tts": {
      "voice_id": "cgSgspJ2msm6clMCkdW9"
    },
    "turn": {
      "interruption_ignore_terms": [
        "okay",
        "right",
        "uh-huh"
      ],
      "silence_end_call_timeout": 45
    }
  },
  "name": "elevenlabs-prod-intake",
  "workflow": {
    "edges": {
      "entry_node_to_group_triage_0_collect": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Run the triage group.",
          "type": "llm"
        },
        "source": "entry_node",
        "target": "group_triage_0_collect"
      },
      "entry_to_task_collect": {
        "forward_condition": {
          "condition": "Collect the caller's account details.",
          "type": "llm"
        },
        "source": "entry_node",
        "target": "task_collect"
      },
      "group_triage_0_collect_to_entry": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "group_triage_0_collect",
        "target": "entry_node"
      },
      "start_to_entry": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "start_node",
        "target": "entry_node"
      },
      "task_collect_to_entry": {
        "forward_condition": {},
        "source": "task_collect",
        "target": "entry_node"
      }
    },
    "nodes": {
      "entry_node": {
        "edge_order": [
          "entry_to_task_collect",
          "entry_node_to_group_triage_0_collect"
        ],
        "entry_behavior": "generate_immediately",
        "label": "Entry",
        "type": "override_agent"
      },
      "group_triage_0_collect": {
        "additional_prompt": "Collect the caller's account tier.",
        "additional_tool_ids": [
          "{{capture:tool:save_tier}}"
        ],
        "edge_order": [
          "group_triage_0_collect_to_entry"
        ],
        "label": "collect",
        "type": "override_agent"
      },
      "start_node": {
        "edge_order": [
          "start_to_entry"
        ]
      },
      "task_collect": {
        "additional_prompt": "Collect the caller's account tier.",
        "additional_tool_ids": [
          "{{capture:tool:save_tier}}"
        ],
        "edge_order": [
          "task_collect_to_entry"
        ],
        "label": "collect",
        "type": "override_agent"
      }
    }
  }
}
